1) to know
1a) (P'al) to know
1b) (Aphel) to let someone know, communicate, inform, cause to know

strongs_1890.strongs_def: {to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.)}
